turns.sql: SELECT c.customer_level AS 客户等级, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS 客户数, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 订单总金额, AVG(o.order_amount) AS 平均订单金额, MIN(o.order_amount) AS 最小订单金额, MAX(o.order_amount) AS 最大订单金额 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY CASE c.customer_level WHEN '战略客户' THEN 1 WHEN '重点客户' THEN 2 WHEN '普通客户' THEN 3 END;
